text:
maya_csm: Hey team — quick heads-up on SolsticeAI onboarding. Customer has been hitting 210ms p95 right now on their chat route and token costs are higher than expected. Renewal chat next month, want to propose a light optimization plan.
rohit_perf: Thanks — do we have the split by prompt length and percentage of short vs long sessions? that drives quantization tradeoffs.
manual: (link to dashboard) https://redwood/dash/solsticeai — short sessions (~65%) but long-tail requests push GPU mem and increase batching latency.
anika_se: My read: good candidate for hybrid approach — int8 quant for short/latency-sensitive path, keep fp16 for long-form so quality stays. can canary model-swap to compact-2 for 20% of traffic.
maya_csm: Perfect. Customer especially worried about hallucination on long generation, so keep quality for >512 tokens. Plan proposal draft:

- Route rules: classify by expected max tokens (client header or sample length)
- For <=256 tokens -> compact-int8 (fast)
- For >256 tokens -> fp16-main
- Canary 20% -> compact-int8 for latency-sensitive route
- Run A/B on rouge/emd/perplexity for 48h and snapshot prompts

rohit_perf: Sounds good. For quantization we should recommend dynamic quant (per-layer) vs global int8? dynamic usually keeps better quality. I'll prepare quant profile and expected cost delta.

anika_se: I'll draft the routing snippet and a rollout plan. Suggest auto-fallback to fp16 if error rate >1% or token drop spikes.

james_oncall: Ops note: ensure KV cache compatibility for compact-int8 variant. Also set WAF/SLAs for canary so they don't blow past quota. I'll add circuit-breaker.

ops-bot: Deploy check: required approvals pending — security-review: complete, perf-runbook: pending, rollout-owner: anika_se.

maya_csm: Customer enablement ask: 30–45 minute sync next Tue to walk through routing header and SDK changes. Can we have a simple SDK snippet to detect expected tokens client-side?

anika_se: yes — will add minimal SDK detect snippet. Example we'll put in the enablement guide:

```javascript
// estimateTokens is cheap heuristic
const estimateTokens = (text) => Math.ceil(text.length / 4);
const route = estimateTokens(prompt) > 256 ? 'fp16-main' : 'compact-int8';
await redwood.send({ model: route, prompt });
```

rohit_perf: I'll attach a small eval harness that runs their top 1000 prompts against both variants and returns delta metrics.

maya_csm: Also capturing feedback for renewal: emphasize 20–30% lower p95 and projected 18% cost saving on token pricing with fallback safety net. If metrics hit our targets we'll include that in the renewal deck.

james_oncall: Added an alert: `route-fallbacks > 1% in 15m` -> Pager to oncall.

anika_se: Plan of action summary I will send to SolsticeAI and copy Maya + Rohit. Will include rollout steps, rollback criteria, and eval notebook link.

maya_csm: Awesome. Tentative enablement time scheduled Tue 10am PT. @rohit_perf @anika_se please confirm you'll have artifacts by Monday EOD.

rohit_perf: Confirmed — quant profile + eval harness by Mon EOD.

anika_se: Confirmed — routing config, SDK snippet, rollout steps by Mon EOD.

maya_csm: Thanks team :raised_hands: I'll ping customer and update renewal notes.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: enablement-sync @ Tue 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent).

maya_csm: Thread closed unless blockers — will reopen if we need to adjust canary percentage after first 6h.
